method: Native1x raster. Flat band runs at y2px; neutral ink y6..26; grouped occupied columns. Mic/chevron measured from left outer edge; History/gear from right outer edge. Glyph identities assigned nearest stable outer inset, so uncertain fragments and crop contact are excluded from invariant summaries. Distances 1px=1pt, about1pt threshold uncertainty. Hidden or clipped ink is UNKNOWN, never zero.

summary: AFTER icons ride with the outer wing edges: fully resolved dark ranges mic19–20pt, chevron46–47pt, History43–44pt, gear18–19pt; light mic19–20pt, chevron46–47pt, History43–44pt, gear17–18pt. Every range spans1pt. Partial icon fragments ARE visible at the inner notch-facing wing edge during emergence/retraction (dark frame017 mic/gear; frame020 History; light frame020 mic/gear and frame024 chevron). No resolved fragment touches the outer wing edge. Thus no blanket unclipped-icon claim. AFTER closing also shifts the recorded band right before shrinking: dark frame060→061 changes notch-gap pixels75–243 to263–416 in the union crop; light frame060→061 changes75–243 to262–416. The raw movie contains the shift. Product versus recorder-compositing cause is NOT VERIFIED. The original endpoint crop cut the shifted right wing; offline union crops include all visible band pixels without scaling. BEFORE opens with icons exposed by the expanding edge, then closes in one sampled cut (frame096→097), so eight distinct moving closing geometries do not exist in that baseline sequence. At least eight source frames bracket each transition; AFTER contains more than eight changing geometries in each direction.
